title: Boundary Cases of the $J$-Equation: Divisorial Rigidity and a Global $C^0$ Estimate
summary: We study two boundary cases of the stability condition for the $J$-equation. First, under the $J$-semistable condition, we show that the destabilizing prime divisors form an exceptional family in the sense of Boucksom, with a uniform numerical gap away from them. The related modified nef estimate can remove the $J$-big assumption in Liu's work~\cite{Liu2026Boundary}. Second, under the smooth boundary cone condition, we obtain a uniform global $C^0$ estimate for solutions of the approximating twisted $J$-equations.
